results.title: PCAD - University of California, Berkeley (UCB), Memorial Stadium, Berkeley, CA
results.snippet: Architect John Galen Howard (1864-1931) designed the Memorial Stadium with G.F. Buckingham and E.E. Carpenter; this was one of the last works by Howard on the UC Berkeley campus. Football fans in the State of California raised a staggering one million dollars in a month to fund the stadium in 1921.
